comparison.objective: Isolate a battery pack, prove it dead, and remove busbars safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Service-plug extraction, meter use, insulated nut driving, and conductive-part handling.
comparison.success_condition: Pack is isolated and proven dead before busbars and nuts reach the tray without bridging terminals.
comparison.reason: Although it includes driver use and nut removal, it tests electrical isolation and disassembly rather than preserving an adjusted setting while tightening a jam nut.
